map.→ 打开效果（评估/归因/报告）模型工具: -> Open the effect (evaluation / attribution / report) model tool
map.单次转化价值怎么估？: How is the value of a single conversion estimated?
map.可用历史客单价×毛利率，或 AOV×预估复购。估算越准，ROI 越可信。本工具按: Use historical average order value x gross margin, or AOV x expected repurchase. The more accurate the estimate, the more credible the ROI. This tool computes from the value you enter; the valuation method should reflect your actual business and is not a basis for financial accounting.
map.周期末汇总各渠道报表，输出'花钱—转化—价值'闭环，向管理层汇报。: At the end of the period, consolidate the reports from every channel and output a closed loop of spend - conversion - value for management reporting.
map.多渠道归因模型计算器，支持首次触达/末次触达/线性/时间衰减/位置归因，对比各渠: Multi-channel attribution model calculator supporting first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay and position-based attribution, comparing the contribution of each channel
map.对多触点路径做加权归因（如末次/线性/时间衰减），分配转化贡献，指导预算再分配。: Apply weighted attribution to multi-touch paths (last-touch, linear, time decay) to allocate conversion contribution and guide budget reallocation.
map.广告尺寸与分辨率转换（像素/毫米）: Ad size and resolution conversion (pixels / millimetres)
map.把各渠道的触点成本、总转化次数、单次转化价值录入，算每个渠道的 ROI，找出高效: Enter the touchpoint cost, total conversions and value per conversion for each channel, compute the ROI per channel and identify the efficient and the wasteful ones.
map.末次归因和首次归因有什么不同？: What is the difference between last-touch and first-touch attribution?
map.末次归因把转化功劳给最后一次点击，利于衡量临门一脚；首次归因给第一次曝光，利于衡: Last-touch attribution credits the conversion to the last click, which is good for measuring the closing touch; first-touch credits the first exposure, which is good for measuring awareness building. In practice linear or time-decay models distribute it. The same channel can show very different ROI under different models, so the report must state which model was used.
map.：渠道 A：成本 1000 元、转化 20 次、单次价值 80 元 → 收入 1: : channel A costs 1,000 CNY with 20 conversions at 80 CNY each, giving revenue of 1,600 and ROI = (1600 - 1000) / 1000 = 60%. Channel B costs 800 CNY with 15 conversions at 100 CNY each, giving revenue of 1,500 and ROI = (1500 - 800) / 800 = 87.5%. B is more efficient, so budget should lean towards it.
